transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, um... I guess I'm here because of my eating. At night, mostly. It's just... once I start, it's like I'm watching myself do it. I tell myself to stop, but... my hands just keep reaching for more. I don't know. It's hard to explain.
Do you feel like you're in control when you're eating at night?
No. Not really. It's... like I said, I just kind of watch myself doing it. I know I should stop, but I just keep reaching for more food. I can't stop it.
Do you feel guilty after these nighttime eating episodes?
I... I don't know about guilty. I'm not really sure. I mostly just... clean up whatever mess I made and go to sleep. I try not to think about it too much.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time during these nighttime episodes?

Yeah, I suppose so. Some evenings I'll... I'll start with just some leftovers. But then I end up eating sandwiches, or cereal, cookies... just whatever snack food is sitting in the pantry. It gets to be a lot. Far more than I would ever put on a plate for a normal supper.
Do you feel like you're eating really fast during these nighttime episodes?
I don't know. I haven't really paid attention to that. I just... eat what's there. I'm not really keeping track of the time.
Do you usually eat at night because you're feeling stressed, anxious, or upset?
I... no, I wouldn't say that. I don't really get anxious or... upset about things. It's just... I just eat. I don't really sit around analyzing why it happens.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating once you've started during these episodes?

I guess you could say that. It's... well, once I start, it almost feels like I'm just watching myself do it. I'll be telling myself to stop, but... my hands just keep going back for more. So, yeah... I suppose I can't.
Do you ever feel like you've eaten an amount of food that's definitely larger than what most people would eat under similar circumstances during these nighttime episodes?

I... yeah, probably. I mean... some evenings I'll just start with leftovers. But then... I don't know, I'll end up having sandwiches, maybe some cereal... cookies, just whatever snack food is sitting around in the pantry. It's... well, it's far more than I would ever put on a plate for a normal supper. So... yes.
Do you usually try to eat at night when you're alone, without others knowing?
I suppose so. My wife goes to bed early, usually around nine. So... yeah, I'm by myself when it happens. I don't really broadcast it.
Do you ever eat at night because you're feeling bored?
I don't think so. I mean... I'm not really sure why I do it. I just do.
Do you feel like you have no control over what you're eating or how much you're eating during these episodes?

I... yeah. That's... that's kind of why I'm here. Once I start... it's like I'm watching myself do it. I tell myself to just stop, put it away, but... my hands just keep reaching for more. I can't seem to make it stop.
Do you ever feel ashamed after one of these nighttime eating episodes?
I don't... I wouldn't necessarily use that word. I just... I don't really dwell on it. I usually just clean up the kitchen and go to sleep.
Do you usually eat at night because you're feeling emotional?
I don't think so. I'm not really... I don't pay much attention to that kind of thing. I'm not a very emotional person to begin with, so... no, I wouldn't say that's it.
Do you ever feel guilty or regretful after these nighttime eating episodes?
I... no. Like I said, I just clean up and go to bed. I don't really think about it much after it's done. It's just... something that happens.
Do you ever have episodes like the ones you described at night, but during the day instead?
No... not really. I'm usually at work during the day, so I'm busy. It's just... no, it doesn't happen then.
Do you ever eat at night when you're feeling emotional, such as sad, angry, or frustrated?
I... didn't we just go over this? No. Like I said before, I'm just not a very emotional guy. I don't sit around feeling sad or angry and then go eat. It's not about that. So... no.
Do these nighttime eating episodes cause you any problems or interfere with your daily life in any way?

I mean... I still go to work. I get my job done, take care of things. But... I guess I've been saying no to some things lately. My wife likes the theater, and we used to do a walking club... I just haven't wanted to go. I don't know, I just... I don't want people looking at me. Wondering if I've let myself go. So I just stay home.
Do you feel like you're eating really fast during these episodes?
I don't really know. I guess... maybe? I haven't really paid attention to how fast I'm eating. It just sort of happens.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop yourself from continuing to eat once you've started eating at night?

I... yeah, I guess so. It's... it's strange. Once I start, it's like I'm just watching myself do it. I'll be sitting there, telling myself to just put the food down, to stop... but my hands just keep reaching for more. I can't seem to make them quit.
Do you typically skip meals during the day?

Yeah, sometimes. If... if I have a bad night with the eating, I usually just skip breakfast the next day. Sometimes lunch, too. I just tell myself I'm making up for it. Or I'll... I'll go for a walk, but I'll push it. Walk for miles past my usual route, even when my knees start acting up and I know I should just head home.
